responsibility: Provides GCC’s standard variable-argument header by defining __gnuc_va_list from __builtin_va_list, exporting va_start, va_end, va_arg, va_copy, and __va_copy as wrappers around compiler builtins, and conditionally introducing va_list while accommodating many system guard conventions and partial-include patterns such as __need___va_list. This file is the front-end-facing bridge between C/C++ source varargs syntax and the target-specific calling-convention support embodied in GCC’s built-in va_list representation.
